Donald Trump's statements and actions draw media attention

Multiple news outlets reported on various statements and actions attributed to Donald Trump. Some coverage focused on his potential future political investigations, with Democrats reportedly planning impeachment inquiries if they gain control of the House. Other reports highlighted Trump's refusal to pledge not to run as a third-party candidate. Additionally, several articles discussed his comments on lawns and grass, including a White House summit with Scotts Miracle-Gro. His changing hairstyle also generated online discussion, and his financial records became a subject in a BBC defamation case.
